resources.string: Unknown error code
This code is not in the Bafang list. Switch the system off and on again. If it comes back, note the code and have a dealer check the bike.
Throttle not back in its rest position
Check that the throttle springs back fully when you let go. If it does and the error stays, the throttle needs replacing.
Throttle fault
Check that the throttle connector is plugged in properly. Unplug the throttle: if the error still appears, have a dealer check the bike.
Overvoltage protection
Remove the battery and insert it again. If the error persists, have a dealer check the bike (wrong battery or charger?).
Motor hall sensor error
Fault in the hall sensor signal inside the motor (not the speed sensor). Check the motor cable and its connector for damage. Usually a dealer repair.
Motor phase error
Problem with the motor phase wires. Check the motor cable for damage; otherwise have a dealer check the bike.
Motor overheated
The motor has reached its protection temperature. Switch off and let it cool down. If it keeps happening, have a dealer check it.
Motor temperature sensor error
The temperature sensor inside the motor reports a fault. Have a dealer check the bike.
Controller current sensor error
The current sensor in the controller reports a fault. Have a dealer check the bike.
Battery temperature sensor error
The temperature sensor inside the battery reports a fault. Have a dealer check the battery.
Controller overheated
The controller has reached its protection temperature. Switch off and let the bike cool down. Also check the motor connectors for dirt or damage. If it persists, have a dealer check it.
Controller temperature sensor error
The temperature sensor inside the controller reports a fault. Have a dealer check the bike.
Speed sensor error
Restart the system. Check that the spoke magnet is in place and passes the speed sensor at 10 to 20 mm, and that the sensor connector is plugged in properly.
Torque signal error
The torque sensor signal is faulty. Check that all connectors are plugged in properly. If it persists, have a dealer check the bike.
Torque sensor speed signal error
Check that the speed sensor connector is plugged in properly and that the sensor is not damaged. If it persists, have a dealer check the bike.
Controller overcurrent
The controller detected too much current. Restart the system; if it comes back, have a dealer check the bike.
Communication problem
The display cannot talk to the motor controller and the motor will not assist. Check all connectors between display, controller and battery. If it persists, have a dealer check the bike.
Brake sensor error
The brake signal is faulty (only with brake sensors). Check the brake sensor connectors and that the levers return fully. If it persists, have a dealer check it.
15 V detection circuit error
Internal electronics fault. Have a dealer check the bike.
Keypad detection circuit error
The button pad reports a fault. Check that no button is stuck or pressed while switching on. If it persists, have a dealer check it.
Watchdog circuit fault
Internal electronics fault. Have a dealer check the bike.
Battery voltage too high
The total battery voltage is too high. Check that the right battery and charger are used. Have a dealer check the battery.
Battery voltage too low
The total battery voltage is too low. Charge the battery. If it persists, have a dealer check the battery.
Battery cell power too high
The battery reports too much power from its cells. Have a dealer check the battery.
Single cell voltage too high
One battery cell has too high a voltage. Have a dealer check the battery.
Battery too hot
Let the battery cool down, out of direct sun. If it persists, have a dealer check the battery.
Battery too cold
Let the battery warm up to room temperature before riding or charging. If it persists, have a dealer check the battery.
Battery charge level too high
The battery reports a charge level that is too high. Have a dealer check the battery and charger.
Battery charge level too low
Charge the battery. If it persists, have a dealer check the battery.
Gear shift detection fault
The shift sensor reports a fault (only with this function). Have a dealer check the bike.
Electronic derailleur cannot release
Only with an electronic derailleur. Have a dealer check the bike.
Electronic lock jammed
Only with an electronic lock. Try to lock and unlock again; otherwise have a dealer check it.
Bluetooth module error
The Bluetooth module of the display reports a fault. Restart the system; if it persists, have a dealer check the display.
